message.hearthbound.died: %s has fallen. Their belongings lie where they fell.
message.hearthbound.no_party: You aren't travelling with any companions. Talk to one and ask them to join you.
message.hearthbound.ai_paused: [Hearthbound] The AI dialogue service isn't responding, so companions will use their own words for a couple of minutes. Orders still work.
message.hearthbound.welcome_tip: These folk are looking for company. Talk to them in chat: "@%1$s hello", or "@%1$s join me" to bring them along. Right-click one to say hi.
message.hearthbound.recruit_hint: Say "@%1$s join me" in chat to ask them along.
message.hearthbound.party_full_server: You already travel with %1$s companions, the most allowed here.
message.hearthbound.chatting: You're talking with %1$s. Just keep typing, no @ needed. Say bye when you're done.
message.hearthbound.help_hint: Type /companion help to see everything you can ask.
message.hearthbound.recruited_tip: %1$s is with you now. Chat away, or try "%1$s, go mining" or "build a shelter". /companion help lists the rest.
message.hearthbound.other_dimension: %s is in another dimension, so they can't hear you from here.
message.hearthbound.not_loaded: %s is too far away to hear you (their part of the world isn't loaded). Go back near them and try again.
